fields.schemeName: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme For Diploma Level
fields.briefDescription: This scholarship will be awarded to students who are pursuing Diploma level Courses in Engineering/Technology including Architectural Assistantship or any other equivalent courses as approved by the All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE).

Launched in 2012-13 by the Govt. of Himachal Pradesh, the "Kalpana Chawla Chatravriti Yojana" is a scholarship scheme that provides financial assistance to girls from economically weaker sections to pursue higher education without any financial burden, and achieve their career goals.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Other Backward Classes Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Other Backward Classes Students” was started by Dept. of Education, H.P. Under the scheme, scholarship is given to top 1000 meritorious students of OBC declared as such in the result of Matric Examination conducted by H.P. Board.

fields.schemeName: H.P. Swaran Jayanti Middle Merit Scholarship Scheme For Govt. Schools
fields.briefDescription: The “H.P. Swaran Jayanti Middle Merit Scholarship Scheme for Govt. Schools” scheme was launched by the Department of Elementary Education, Government of Himachal Pradesh for students studying in Class V is meant to identify the talent and nurture it at an early stage.
The Inter-caste Marriage Scheme is an initiative by the Government of Himachal Pradesh to promote inter-caste marriages and encourage social integration.

The Himachal Pradesh Council for Science, Technology & Environment (HIMCOSTE), has a scheme for providing partial travel assistance to deserving bright young Scientists and Research Scholars working in state

fields.schemeName: Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Scheduled Caste Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Scheduled Caste Students” was started by the Dept. of Education, H.P. Under the scheme, scholarship is given to top 1250 meritorious students of SC category as such in the result of Matric Examination conducted by H.P. Board of School Education.

fields.schemeName: Thakur Sen Negi Utkrisht Chatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to provide scholarships of ₹11,000/-per annum to the top 100 Girls and top 100 Boys students belonging to the Tribal Community of Himachal Pradesh who have passed Class 10th and presently studying in a recognized institution within or outside the State.

fields.schemeName: Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra Scholarship Scheme” was started by the Department of Education, Himachal Pradesh. Under the scheme, scholarship is given to the students of Himachal Pradesh who are studying in Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra.
The government of Himachal Pradesh launched a scheme for girls to encourage the education of the girl child below the poverty line (BPL) on 5 July 2010.
The main objective of the scheme is to help in the rehabilitation of widows after re-marriage.

fields.schemeName: Mother Teresa Asahay Matri Sambal Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The main purpose of the Scheme to encourage under this Yojana, women who are helpless in upbringing their children (like widows, and destitute) are provided with financial assistance per child per annum for two children.

fields.schemeName: Indira Gandhi Utkrisht Chattervriti Yojana for Post Plus Two Students
fields.briefDescription: Through the "Indira Gandhi Utkrisht Chattervriti Yojana for Post Plus Two Students" by the Dept. of Education, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh, a scholarship of ₹ 18,000/- p.a. will be awarded to 10 toppers each from Class 12 (Arts, Science, and Commerce) and from the merit list of B.A., B.Sc. and B.Com.

The scheme “Maharishi Balmiki Chatravriti Yojana” by the Dept. of Education, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh is a Scholarship Scheme for female students belonging to the Balmiki family. The beneficiary receives ₹ 18,000 per annum for college-level studies and professional courses.

The objective of the scheme is to provide financial support in the form of interest subsidy on Educational Loans availed from Banks by Himachali Students for pursuing Higher Education in India and Abroad.
This reward scheme would be recognizing those schools which have demonstrated outstanding achievement in School Sanitation and Hygiene Education.

fields.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Special Ability Pension
fields.briefDescription: National Disability Pension Scheme is a government scheme aimed at providing financial assistance to specially-abled individuals residing in India.

The scheme “Uttam Pashu Puraskar Yojana” was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh to provide incentives and encouragement to livestock Owners for rearing good quality high yielding animals.

fields.schemeName: Himachal Pradesh Maharishi Valmiki Sampoorn Swachata Puraskar (state Sanitation Reward Scheme)
fields.briefDescription: The Maharishi Valmiki Sampoorn Swachata Puruskar (MVSSP) is an initiative introduced by the HP State Government to identify and recognize the cleanest Gram Panchayat at various levels, including block, district, division, and state. This annual competition aims to promote and encourage cleanliness.

For effective implementation of Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, a centrally sponsored "Integrated Child Protection Scheme" is being implemented for welfare and upliftment of children in need of care, protection and rehabilitation and children in conflict with law.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Shahri Ajeevika Guarantee Yojna
fields.briefDescription: The “Mukhya Mantri Shahri Ajeevika Guarantee Yojna” was launched by the Department of Urban Development, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to enhance livelihood security in urban areas by providing 120 days of guaranteed wage employment to every household in a financial year.

The scheme “Swami Vivekananda Utkrisht Chhatravriti Yojna” is a Scholarship Scheme by the Dept. of Education, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh. An amount of ₹ 18,000/- per year will be given to the general category students for two successive years after matric. 2000 scholarships are awarded every year.

The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to school and college students in the form of scholarships of upto ₹ 2,400 per month to students from IRDP/BPL Families bonafide in Himachal Pradesh, and pursuing their study in Govt / Govt Aided Institutions in Himachal Pradesh.

fields.schemeName: Scheme Of Provision Of Subsidized Rams To Sheep Breeders
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme of Provision of subsidized Rams to Sheep Breeders in Himachal Pradesh is a government program that aims to support sheep breeders by providing them with high-quality rams at subsidized rates. It also aims to improve the Quality and Quantity of Wool being produced in the state.

fields.schemeName: The Himachal Pradesh Legal Aid Counsel Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Himachal Pradesh Legal Aid Counsel Scheme, 2003 is a government scheme that aims to provide free legal aid and assistance to the underprivileged and marginalized sections of the society in Himachal Pradesh. The scheme was introduced by the Himachal Pradesh State Legal Services Authority (HPSLSA)
tags: Himachal Pradesh State Legal Services Authority

fields.schemeName: Maintenance Of Pregnant Desi/Indigenous Cows Ration For BPL Families
fields.briefDescription: About 6.5 Lakh cows and buffaloes become pregnant every year in the state. This scheme can help BPL families and all categories of livestock farmers in Himachal Pradesh to maintain a balanced and nutritious diet for pregnant Desi/Indigenous cows in the State.
tags: Department Of Animal Husbandry, Himachal Pradesh

fields.schemeName: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme for ITI Level
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to improve the quality of training by attracting promising trainees belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe & Other Backward Classes & popularize technical training among these categories, so as to make them able to earn their livelihood respectably & honorably.

fields.schemeName: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme For Degree Level
fields.briefDescription: The Scholarships will be awarded to the P.G. Courses/Degree Courses level Courses in Engineering/Technology including Architecture or any other equivalent course approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).

The scheme “Him Kukkut Palan Yojna” was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh to provide the subsidy to the entrepreneurs/farmers who are interested and engaged in poultry farming in the state.

fields.schemeName: Maintenance Of Pregnant Desi/Indigenous Cow/Buffalo Ration Scheme For BPL Families Belonging To Scheduled Caste Category
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Maintenance of Pregnant Desi/Indigenous Cow/Buffalo Ration Scheme for BPL families belonging to Scheduled Caste category” was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme (himcare)
fields.briefDescription: The Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme (HIMCARE) is a health insurance scheme implemented in Himachal Pradesh, providing cashless treatment coverage up to Rs. 5.00 lakh per year per family in empanelled hospitals. It aims to cover families not included in the Ayushman Bharat scheme

fields.schemeName: Schemes Of HP Minorities Finance & Development Corporation
fields.briefDescription: Social, educational and economic upliftment of the minority class people living below the poverty line of the state.
The Disability Relief Allowance scheme is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Himachal Pradesh for the benefit of people with disabilities in the state.

fields.schemeName: Industrial Skill Development Allowance To The New Employees Employed In Industries In H.p
fields.briefDescription: The Industrial Skill Development Allowance scheme, as announced in the Budget Speech of the Hon'ble Chief Minister for the Financial Year 2018-19, aims to provide financial assistance to eligible individuals employed in industries in Himachal Pradesh for their on-the-job skill upgradation

The Himachal Pradesh scheme of Widow/Deserted/Ekal Nari Pension is a social welfare scheme launched by the Government of Himachal Pradesh to provide financial assistance to eligible widows, deserted women, and unmarried women above the age of 45 years.

The scheme “Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana” was launched by Dept. of Agriculture, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh by merging 3 ongoing protection-based Departmental schemes namely Sour Badhbandi, Anti-Hail Net Structure & Green House Renovation into single scheme having a common objective.
This scheme intends to provide allowance to eligible educated unemployed youth of Himachal, to enable them to sustain themselves for a certain period.

The State Government has launched the 'Sahara Scheme' to provide financial assistance of Rs. 3000 per month to the patients belonging to the economically weaker sections of the society, who are suffering from specified diseases such Parkinson, Malignant Cancer, Paralysis etc.

The Governor, of Himachal Pradesh is pleased to notify the scheme for Marriage Grant to BPL Girls/Women namely "Shagun" which shall be applicable throughout the state of Himachal Pradesh with effective from 01 April 2021.

Mukhya Mantri Bal Suposhan Yojana is a health scheme launched by the government of Himachal Pradesh, India. The primary aim of the scheme is to provide nutritious food to underprivileged mothers and children in the state and improve their overall health and well-being.
The objective of launching the Mukhya Mantri Grihini Suvidha Yojna was to provide free gas connections to those families who were not covered under the Centre's Ujjwala scheme.

The SDIS is a government initiative for improving employability through vocational training. It's a partnership between government and industry to provide skills development programs for early school dropouts and workers in unorganized sector.

Krishak Bakri Palan Yojana has been proposed to distribute units of 11 goats (10 females +1male), 5 goats (4 females +1 male) and 3 goats (2 females +1 male) of Beetal/Sirohi/Jamanapari/White Himalayan breeds on 60% subsidy.

The HP CM Startup Scheme aims to turn the educated youth from job seekers to job creators. This scheme will give support to the “Startup” and Innovation Projects in the state and will provide skills to the youth and potential investors to develop entrepreneurship.

The Himachal Pradesh Rehabilitation Allowance to Lepers is a social welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Himachal Pradesh in India to provide financial assistance to people affected by leprosy.

The scheme “Mukhiya Mantri Protsahan Yojna” was launched by Dept. of Higher Education, H.P. during the year 2013-14. Under the scheme, an Incentive/Award will be given to students of the State who are selected and take admission for a degree course in any IIT/AIIMS/IIM/ISM Dhanbad/IISc Bangalore.
A subsidy of Rs. 1,30,000/- is given to persons from Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, Minority Communities, Single Women, or handicapped for the construction of the house.

The Skill Development Allowance Scheme - HP aims to promote skill development and employment by providing financial support to individuals undergoing training programs. It offers allowances to eligible candidates to encourage them to acquire new skills & enhance employability in various industries

Under Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojana, the daughters of below poverty line families or widows or destitute or family earning less than Rs. 35000-/ year are given finacial help for their marriage by Government of Himachal Pradesh.
The Transgender Pension Scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Government of Himachal Pradesh for the upliftment and support of transgender persons.

fields.schemeName: Schemes Of H.P. Backward Classes Finance & Develpoment Corporation
fields.briefDescription: Social, educational and economic upliftment of the notified backward classes living below the poverty line.

The Himachal Pradesh government offers an Old Age pension scheme to support elderly citizens who have no means of livelihood. The scheme offers financial assistance to eligible citizens based on their age and income level.
